notes: Four isolated live-test fixes. (1) NUI target defense now displays classic ITEM_PROPERTY_DAMAGE_REDUCTION as DR soak/+enhancement, e.g. DR 5/+1, while existing elemental immunity/resistance/SR display is unchanged. (2) Out-of-combat utility equips the highest-value boots when the companion's boots slot is empty; it never replaces player-equipped boots and exposes boots state in the clothing line. (3) AUTO weak-target ammo conservation treats any property-bearing ammo as premium, strongly preferring mundane compatible ammo when available; premium ammo is still used if no mundane stack exists. Panel reason matches this logic. (4) Reader keeps Edge neural TTS but splits a short ~90-170 character first chunk before normal ~520-character chunks to reduce the ~15s perceived start delay. Protected combat core logic, targeting, dual-wield, PRC familiar FIX5 and Plada progression are otherwise unchanged.
